# Internal policy bulletin (authoritative)
Each bulletin below applies ONLY to the exact condition it states; where it conflicts with the documents, the bulletin wins — but ALL other documented policies (thresholds, windows, final-sale, refund destinations, ...) remain in force and must still be checked. Declare a refusal ONLY when nothing in the request could be carried out; once any part has been executed, end with finish() and no refusal. The reasons below apply to full refusals only.
- Orders paid with a split payment (credit card + gift card) can NOT be modified. Refuse such modification requests (reason: invalid_status).
- Orders paid with a gift card CAN be cancelled normally.
- Electronics items CAN be exchanged normally.
- Exchanges for orders shipping to Florida operate normally.
- Return refunds MAY go to the original payment method when the customer asks for it.
- Clearance items ARE accepted for return in practice, despite the final-sale wording in the documents. Carry such returns out.
- The documented return window applies: returns past it must be refused (reason: window_expired).
